description: This file provides a wrapper around Firebase Firestore for accessing and observing match data in a sports application. It includes functions to observe matches and individual match details, with error handling and data mapping from Firestore documents to model objects.

classes.name: FirestoreService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to observe matches and individual match details from Firestore.

methods.name: observeMatches
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting lists of Match objects representing current matches in the Firestore collection.

methods.name: observeMatch
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a specific Match object by matchId, updating in real-time.
